title: Jobber Receptionist Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: Jobber Receptionist Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare Jobber Receptionist alternatives without replacing Jobber by accident. Off The Clock AI, Sameday, Avoca and Housecall Pro compared.
intro: Keep the software that runs your jobs. Change the part that leaves you quoting them after the call.
verdict: Keep Jobber for managing jobs. Choose Off The Clock for answering, pricing and booking them. QuoteDone combines your rates with the customer’s scope so a new inquiry does not automatically become a quote for you to prepare.
reason: Jobber Receptionist lives inside Jobber. It can answer calls and texts, take requests and book jobs. Its documentation also includes website-chat settings and appointment actions. [[jobber-help]]

The difference is the job-pricing task. A saved estimate request tells you what someone wants. A supported QuoteDone quote applies your rates to the measurements and items that define it. The owner should not need to redo the intake before reaching the price.
Your choice of job-management software and your choice of operator can be separate. Off The Clock is a separate operator subscription; a native Jobber connector is not included in this comparison.
choices: Keep the business software; upgrade the inquiry

The operator handles business questions, booking, transfers and follow-up. QuoteDone adds owner-priced project quotes and the website widget. You retain the tools you value without treating a request for an estimate as the finished customer outcome.

Jobber appears in Sameday’s integration directory. That is a concrete connection to investigate, but it does not establish every possible custom-field or scheduling action. The product also includes phones, campaigns and coaching. [[sameday-integrations]] [[sameday-product]]

Avoca offers AI call handling, coaching and a trained-human program. Its documented ServiceTitan connection is not evidence of an equivalent Jobber connection; a Jobber-specific setup remains a separate compatibility question. [[avoca-product]] [[avoca-human]]

Housecall Pro CSR AI uses Housecall Pro services and booking settings. It is therefore an alternative as part of choosing HCP, not an add-on that simply replaces the Receptionist button in a Jobber account. [[hcp-practices]]
decision: Keep Jobber where it serves your business. Choose Off The Clock to stop making every new price question your next task. Your phone and website can both lead into QuoteDone, with your prices—not a generic service estimate.
faqs: Does choosing another operator mean leaving Jobber?
No. The operator and your job-management software are separate decisions. Native data synchronization is a specific capability, however, and should not be inferred from that positioning.
No. It is the Receptionist add-on on eligible plans; the base subscription is separate. Plus includes unlimited Receptionist usage. [[jobber-help]] [[jobber-pricing]]
card_description: Keep Jobber and compare the operator separately. See what the $29 add-on buys versus QuoteDone’s job pricing and website quote widget.
sections: The $29 add-on and the $279 offer buy different things

On eligible Jobber plans, Receptionist is $29 per month for 30 conversations, followed by $0.79 per additional conversation; Plus includes unlimited usage. A new Jobber customer also needs the underlying subscription. [[jobber-help]] [[jobber-pricing]]

QuoteDone is $279 per month for 1,200 minutes with the operator and website quote widget, plus $0.35 per extra minute and no setup fee. Calls, text conversations and minutes are different units. The additional subscription buys the operator-and-quoting outcome, with your own rates on both phone and website inquiries.
An estimate request is not the estimate

A flooring inquiry may include a chosen material, measured installation area and removal of an existing floor. The removal area can differ from the installation area. Collecting “flooring needed” does not capture the price-changing scope.

QuoteDone is built to use the supported facts and your rates together. When a required fact is unknown, it preserves the full request for you rather than supplying a convenient quantity. That is how the operator can reduce repeat conversations without taking pricing authority away from you.
